paragraphs: Harris Local Government supplies the back office software that cities, counties and other local public bodies run on. It frames its own purpose as helping local officials work through problems.

The range covers accounting, payroll, property records and tax administration for county and municipal operations. Fund accounting products are built specifically around the reporting rules local governments work under. Workforce tools handle employee time, scheduling, overtime and leave. Beyond finance there are records management and imaging systems for preserving and retrieving public records, plus mapping and land records tools for property information.

The offering is not only software: outsourced printing and mailing runs from data processing through to delivery. Printed business forms for everyday government paperwork are sold as well. At least one line is aimed at a single state's counties and extends into public safety operations.

quote.text: We assist local government leaders solve problems and help communities reach their potential
